sha256sum -c <<< '4543670b589593f8fa5f106111fd5139081da42bb165a9239f05195e405f240a  /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip'

npx gulp
npx cap sync

sha256sum -c <<< '0d2a5af33c7deab5555c8309cd3f373446fe1526c1b95833935ab3f019733b3b  /tmp/nodejs-lts.tar.xz'
tar xf /tmp/nodejs-lts.tar.xz -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-v22.13.1-linux-x64/bin"
npm install
npx gulp
npx cap sync
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
